metadata.scenario: A prospect calls to find out if the facility offers aquatic therapy and the costs involved. Category: New Inquiry. Customer type: prospect.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret, how can I help you today? Hi, my name is Susan Garcia. I was referred by my father's pulmonologist. Nice to meet you, Susan. How can I assist you regarding your father’s care? Well, my father has COPD, and I want to know if you offer aquatic therapy. I understand. Unfortunately, we do not offer aquatic therapy at this time. Oh, I see. That's disappointing. What other respiratory care options do you provide? We provide skilled nursing care that includes respiratory assessments and medication management. That sounds helpful. Can you tell me more about that? Of course! Our skilled nursing care starts at $95 and includes monitoring and assistance with breathing treatments. How long are those sessions? Each session typically lasts between 1 to 2 hours, depending on your father's needs. That could work. Are there any other services that could assist him? We also offer personal care assistance for daily activities and companion care for social interaction. And what are the costs for those services? Personal care assistance is $28 to $35 per hour, and companion care is $25 to $30 per hour. Got it. Would I be able to get a care plan developed? Yes, our care coordinator can assist with that. Would you like me to connect you? Yes, please! That would be great. Perfect, let me transfer you to Lisa Chen, our Care Coordinator. Thank you! Just a moment, please. (transferring call) Lisa, you have a call from Susan Garcia regarding her father's care. (pausing) Susan, I’m connecting you now. Thank you so much, Margaret. I appreciate your help! You’re welcome, Susan. Take care. (call connects to Lisa Chen) Hi Susan, this is Lisa. How can I assist you today?
